ambiguities.detail: 76 route files registered via a flat central map (src/http/route-map.ts -> registerRoutes(app)); each exports register(app) calling app.route({method, url, handler}) with literal URLs (method may be a string array). Fastify route detection is out of v0.1-alpha scope: routes[] is deliberately empty. A Next-only detector must report the boundary, never fabricate routes — and must not mistake the onRoute observer hook or test app.inject() calls for registrations.

Handlers branch inside on request.method (subjects.ts); auth via in-handler requireAuth, not preHandler hooks. What each method does and which routes require auth is Inferred (needs handler-body reading).
Tenant Postgres pools resolved per-request from the API token (src/db/tenant.ts) — data-layer routing invisible in the route table; which tenant a route serves is Unknown by design.

entryPoints.form: buildApp() from './app.js' + app.listen({ host, port }) with host/port from src/config/env.js
entryPoints.note: Named directly by package.json scripts (dev: tsx src/server.ts, start: node dist/server.js). No 'main'. src/app.ts exports buildApp() without listen (test-friendly; tests use app.inject).

excludedFacts.detail: Per-route HTTP method lists are literal in app.route() calls but not enumerated file-by-file in the fixture (out-of-scope detector).
Cron/queue/event flows not observed in inspected files.

importCases.note: NodeNext .js->.ts mapping; pure ESM, no aliases, no barrels (analyzer probe: R)
Central route-map pattern: 76 aliased '{ register }' imports with .js extensions -> .ts leaves (analyzer probe: R)

noise.pattern: tests/unit/**, tests/integration/** — app.inject({method, url}) calls look like route registrations to a naive detector; tests/ must be excluded
scripts/, docs/, config/, src/skills/ (skill definitions, not HTTP)
